A '''pilot''' served in the [[Imperial Navy]]. In [[2 BBY]], shortly before the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] establishment, the [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|pilot]] accompanied [[Vult Skerris]] in pursuit of [[Mon Mothma]], a [[Treason|traitor]] who had spoken out against the [[Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Operation Handoff|chase]] in the [[Archeon Nebula]], he was killed when his [[TIE/IN interceptor|TIE interceptor]] was disintegrated by the heat of a protostar forming there.<ref name="SC" />
